Take regional trains RE8, RB23, or RE7 to Bahnhof Berlin Friedrichstraße.
Transfer to underground line U6 (direction Alt-Tegel) and exit at U Naturkundemuseum (2 stops).
Ticket (zones A+B): €4,00

Take the FEX to Gesundbrunnen.
Transfer to S-Bahn lines S2, S25, or S26 (southbound) to Berlin Nordbahnhof, followed by a 5-minute walk.
Ticket (zones A+B+C): €5,00
